chunks: Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام forbade hoarding in the cities.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: the Commander of the Faithful, a title of Imam 'Ali عليه السلام
key_terms.الْأَمْصَارِ: the cities or populated urban centers
key_terms.الْحُكْرَةِ: hoarding of goods to create scarcity or raise prices

ai.seo_question: What did Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام rule about hoarding in cities?
ai.summary: This hadith states that Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام prohibited hoarding in urban centers. It indicates a legal and social concern for preventing economic harm and protecting the public from artificial scarcity.
